title.zh: Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand Central Banks Push Cross-Border Stablecoin and
title.en: Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand Central Banks Push Cross-Border Stablecoin and

current_state.zh: Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand central banks are partnering with Ripple, Visa, Mastercard, Airwallex and the World Bank Group to build cross-border settlement using regulated stablecoins and tokenized deposits, emphasizing payment-network interoperability and programmable compliance.
current_state.en: Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand central banks are partnering with Ripple, Visa, Mastercard, Airwallex and the World Bank Group to build cross-border settlement using regulated stablecoins and tokenized deposits, emphasizing payment-network interoperability and programmable compliance.
